title: A global workspace in language models
summary: Anthropic 发布研究，揭示 Claude 模型中存在类似人脑“全局工作空间”的内部结构。通过因果干预实验，团队发现删除该区域会导致模型性能显著下降，表明该结构对维持智能行为至关重要。这一发现为理解大语言模型的内部机制提供了新视角，可能推动更可解释的 AI 设计。

title: Claude的脑子里，也长出了一块「意识」

summary: 量子位报道，研究人员在 Claude 模型内部发现类似大脑的“意识”空间，删除该区域会导致模型变“傻”。该发现来自对模型内部表征的深入分析，揭示了语言模型中可能存在的核心认知结构，为理解 AI 的推理机制提供了重要线索。

title: ByteDance set to launch Seedance 2.5 with 3-minute AI video output
raw_excerpt: ByteDance is rumored to be launching its Dreamina Seedance 2.5 model on July 9. Availability is expected across Dreamina, CapCut, and other ByteDance partner platforms. The new model can output 180-second-long videos, but it is unclear whether it can keep character identity, motion, camera logic, and prompt intent stable.
summary: 字节跳动被曝将于 7 月 9 日发布 Dreamina Seedance 2.5 模型，支持生成最长 3 分钟的 AI 视频。该模型将集成到 Dreamina、CapCut 等平台，标志着 AI 视频生成时长从秒级迈向分钟级，但角色一致性、运动逻辑等稳定性仍有待验证。

title: OpenAI might be preparing GPT-5.6 for next week's release
raw_excerpt: OpenAI has moved GPT-5.6 into a narrow preview, splitting it into three tiers: Sol, Terra, and Luna. A notable change includes a new reasoning-effort control slider and an "ultra" mode for handling complex tasks. The release has implications for Codex users, amid Anthropic's Fable 5 changes, while broad access depends on US government review approvals.
summary: OpenAI 可能于下周发布 GPT-5.6，分为 Sol、Terra、Luna 三个层级，新增推理努力控制滑块和“超”模式以处理复杂任务。该版本对 Codex 用户有重要影响，但广泛使用仍需美国政府审查批准，反映出 AI 监管对前沿模型发布的制约。

title: Leanstral
raw_excerpt: Leanstral is an open-source 119B-parameter theorem-proving and code-verification agent built on Mistral's general-purpose coding framework.
summary: Mistral AI 开源 Leanstral，一个 119B 参数的定理证明与代码验证智能体。基于 Mistral 的通用编码框架，Leanstral 能够自动验证代码正确性，为 AI 辅助形式化验证提供了强大的开源工具，有望提升软件可靠性和安全性。

title: LeRobot v0.6.0: Imagine, Evaluate, Improve
summary: Hugging Face 发布 LeRobot v0.6.0，新增“想象、评估、改进”三大功能模块。该版本强化了机器人学习框架的仿真与评估能力，支持更高效的策略迭代，为具身智能研究提供了更完善的工具链，降低了机器人算法开发的门槛。

title: alibaba/page-agent
raw_excerpt: JavaScript in-page GUI agent. Control web interfaces with natural language.
summary: 阿里巴巴开源 Page Agent，一个基于 JavaScript 的页面内 GUI 智能体，支持用自然语言控制网页界面。该项目允许用户通过指令自动完成网页操作，如填写表单、点击按钮等，为浏览器自动化和 RPA 领域提供了新的开源方案。

title: Your family’s $300 stake in OpenAI
raw_excerpt: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here . OpenAI CEO Sam Altman’s oft-discussed promise that Americans will share in the wealth AI creates was in the news again last week. On Thursday, the Financial Times reported that Altman is in talks with President Trump about giving the US government a 5% stake in OpenAI. In some ways, Altman’s plan is old news. He wrote about a more radical version of this back in 2021 , proposing that all companies above a certain valuation (not just AI companies) pay 2.5% of their market value each year into a fund that sends Americans annual disbursements. In April this year, OpenAI described a narrower proposal that closely resembles what Altman is reportedly discussing with Trump now. And the notion has broad political appeal: Senator Bernie Sanders has proposed giving Americans a 50% stake in top AI companies. What’s the logic here? For would-be recipients, it’s twofold. First, AI learns directly from human-generated work—books, movies, art—but AI companies generally never pay the authors of that work. A free equity stake could serve as a form of belated compensation. Second, the payout could mitigate the widespread anxiety that AI will cause a collapse of the labor market (even if economists disagree ) by providing a safety net. How large a safety net is up for debate. Details of OpenAI’s latest proposal are sparse, but let’s say the government were …
summary: MIT Tech Review 分析 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 与特朗普政府谈判，拟向美国政府提供 5% 股份的计划。文章指出，Altman 早在 2021 年就提出类似设想，但此次谈判标志着 AI 公司治理与公共利益分配进入新阶段，引发关于 AI 财富共享的广泛讨论。
